turns.text: 8200 EUR works non-bindingly. Does that include acoustic underlayment? Also, are you available for a site visit on 2026-11-02T10:00:00+01:00?

turns.speaker: renovator_agent
turns.text: Yes, underlayment is included. I cannot do 10:00, but can we meet on 2026-11-02 at 14:00?
